Case_09010/figure2.jpg.source_caption: CT of the head, coronal view.

description.short_caption: Coronal CT of the head showing sinus and orbital regions.
description.detailed_description: This coronal CT image of the head demonstrates the paranasal sinuses, orbits, and surrounding structures. The image shows symmetrical bony structures and soft tissues, with no obvious fractures or gross abnormalities visible. The sinuses appear aerated, and the orbital contents are intact. The scan is non-contrast, as no enhancement is visible.
visible_findings: no visible fractures or gross abnormalities

Case_09010/figure1.jpg.source_caption: CT of the head, axial view.

description.short_caption: Axial CT of the head showing sinus involvement.
description.detailed_description: This axial CT image of the head demonstrates significant soft tissue swelling and opacification of the maxillary sinuses bilaterally. There is evidence of mucosal thickening and possible fluid levels within the sinuses, suggestive of sinusitis. The nasal cavity also appears narrowed, and there is asymmetry in the surrounding soft tissues. No obvious bony destruction is visible in this slice.

description.short_caption: Axial T2-weighted MRI of the face.
description.detailed_description: This is an axial T2-weighted MRI image of the face. The image demonstrates high signal intensity in the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses, consistent with fluid or inflammation. The surrounding soft tissues and bony structures appear intact without obvious mass lesions. The cerebellum and brainstem are partially visible inferiorly, with normal signal intensity.
visible_findings: high signal intensity in nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses
intact surrounding soft tissues and bony structures
normal cerebellum and brainstem signal intensity

Case_09010/figure4.jpg.source_caption: MRI of the face (T1 post gadolinium, fat-saturated).

description.short_caption: MRI of the face (T1 post gadolinium, fat-saturated).
description.detailed_description: This axial T1-weighted MRI image with gadolinium contrast and fat saturation shows the facial structures, including the sinuses, orbits, and soft tissues. The image demonstrates symmetrical enhancement patterns without obvious focal lesions or asymmetry. The cerebellum and posterior fossa structures are also visible in the lower portion of the image.

Case_09010/figure5.jpg.source_caption: Cytological exam of aspirate (Papanicolaou stain, x 250).

description.short_caption: Cytological exam of aspirate with Papanicolaou stain at 250x magnification.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a cytological preparation stained with Papanicolaou stain at 250x magnification. The central area contains a dense aggregation of cells with a reddish-pink cytoplasm and darkly stained nuclei. Surrounding the central cluster are scattered cells and debris. The staining highlights cellular details, aiding in the evaluation of morphology and potential infectious or neoplastic processes.
